title: Unit-Size Disposal Charge, Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts Haul-Away
content:
For the haul-away of equipment Bridgewell replaced under a Homeowner Service Contract, a unit-size charge is added to the disposal charge, set by the replaced unit's contracted replacement cost as recorded on its replacement authorization:

| Contracted replacement cost of the replaced unit | Unit-size charge |
|---|---|
| 2000.00 or more | 15.00 |
| at least 800.00 but less than 2000.00 | 8.00 |
| less than 800.00 | nothing |

**Edges.** 2,000.00 takes 15.00; 1,999.99 takes 8.00; 800.00 takes 8.00; 799.99 takes nothing.

*Hypothetical:* a heat pump replaced at a contracted cost of 4,200.00 adds 15.00; a garbage disposal replaced at 410.00 adds nothing.
